summary: Frontend-only verification of Treesh single-file SPA covering (A) horizontal-overflow protection with Magic Markup edit mode, (B) swipe-to-close sheet behavior, (C) Studio widgets (Instrum/LyricFlow/ImageStudio), (D) 16 painterly onboarding avatars, (E1) Settings/onboarding account UI with no-SB-key placeholder, (E2) _sbtest.html signup happy path + validation, (E3) _sbtest.html sign in from onboarding on a fresh device, and (E6) global-search path. Most core flows pass. Two functional issues found: (1) avatar is NOT uploaded to storage on signup (upload call is missing from __mockLog and profile row avatar_url stays null), (2) quick ~60-100ms flick drag of the song-menu panel does NOT close it in the test harness (slow drag correctly springs back, but the flick threshold either requires more pixels or a faster velocity than the CDP touch dispatcher produced). zh/music-manager/profile 'sheets' are actually full-screen views (not .pm-panel) so their 'drag the top handle down to close' was not reproducible with the generic .pm-grab path.

ui_bugs.issue: After a valid signup in _sbtest.html with state.profile.avatar=OB_AVATARS[9] (data:image/webp;base64,...), the mock __mockLog contains only create/signup/select/upsert calls - NO 'upload' call to the 'avatars' bucket, and the resulting profiles row has avatar_url: null. Spec requires: 'avatar_url set (upload logged in __mockLog with upsert:true to avatars/<uid>/avatar.webp)'. Means a new account does NOT get the user's avatar synced to Storage, so other devices will not see the picture.

Quick ~60-80px flick in <100ms on the open song-menu .pm-grab did NOT close the sheet in automated CDP touch dispatching. Slow 50px drag correctly springs back (sheet stays open). Longer slow drags (450px) do close. Likely either the velocity threshold is too strict for the CDP touch dispatcher, or the pm-grab handler is checking time elapsed differently than the UI touch pipeline reports. Suggest E1 confirm with manual swipe on a real device; if the velocity path is intended, consider a lower bar (e.g. v>0.4 px/ms) and/or treat >60px short-duration as a close.

zhOpen(), openMusicManager(), openProfile() do NOT render as .pm-panel sheets with a .pm-grab top handle - they render as full-screen overlays (music-manager at 0,0 w390 h844; settings-profile at ~30,12 w357 h902). There is no visible drag handle, so the spec's 'drag the sheet's top bar/handle down to close' is unreachable via the common handle for these three. If the spec intends them to be sheets, add a .pm-grab/sheet-grab element and the pm-panel chrome; otherwise document that only the four true sheets (song menu, equalizer, add-to-playlist, MK add, sb-auth) support drag-to-close.

action_items: HIGH: Fix signup avatar upload. After a successful signup when state.profile.avatar is a data: URL, sbPush/sbSave* should (a) blob-decode the data URL, (b) call supabase.storage.from('avatars').upload(`${uid}/avatar.webp`, blob, {upsert:true, contentType:'image/webp'}), (c) set profile.avatar_url to the returned public URL, (d) upsert the profiles row again. Verify in _sbtest.html that __mockLog contains an 'upload' entry and __mock_sb_db.profiles[uid].avatar_url is a non-null string.

MEDIUM: Investigate why a short/fast CDP touch flick doesn't close song-menu via .pm-grab (slow drag closes; slow 50px springs back fine). Likely the pm drag code requires either (distance>=X AND v>=Y) OR (distance>=large). Lower one of the thresholds or add a velocity-only close path.

MEDIUM: Decide whether zhOpen / openMusicManager / openProfile should be sheets (with .pm-grab top handle + drag-to-close) or stay as full-screen views. If sheets, wrap them in .pm-panel with a .pm-grab and reuse the same drag handler. If views, update the spec accordingly.
NICE: Add data-testid='search-overlay-root' or similar so tests can enter the search overlay without racing other sheets.

NICE: On fresh storage, the natural onboarding render path works, but programmatic `onboard.step=0; renderOnboarding()` after a profile has been set does NOT render the onboarding-account-row (state.profile check hides it). Not a bug - documenting for next tester.
critical_code_review_comments: Tailwind CDN production warning in console is expected per the single-file app design (not an issue).

sbPush path appears to upsert the profile row before/without uploading the avatar - the sequence should be: upload -> getPublicUrl -> upsert with avatar_url. See /app/memory/p9g.js around sbPush / sbSave* and the sbsave1-3 blocks in /app/memory/patch_p9.py.

zh/musicManager/profile are rendered inline, not inside .pm-panel. If they are intended to behave like sheets (per Task B), add the same wrapper + grab handle; otherwise consider removing them from the 'sheets that must close by drag' list in the spec.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (A, D, E1, C-core, E2-validation, E2-core, E3 all pass; one HIGH avatar-upload bug, two MEDIUM drag-close gaps; E4/E5/E6 not exercised in this iteration)

rca of the issue: Avatar not synced on signup: sbPush likely writes the profiles row via upsert({id, username, display_name, avatar_url, bio}) but does not run the storage upload branch when state.profile.avatar is a data: URL. Expected sequence per spec and p9g.js: detect data:/blob URL -> upload to avatars/<uid>/avatar.webp with upsert:true -> use getPublicUrl.data.publicUrl as avatar_url -> upsert row. Repro: in _sbtest.html seed __mock_sb_db={autoConfirm:true,users:{},profiles:{},files:{}} and treesh_profile with avatar=OB_AVATARS[9], Settings->sb-card-signup, submit email+password, then window.__mockLog - no 'upload' entry; __mock_sb_db.profiles[uid].avatar_url === null.
